synthesized.description: Locomotive engines are silent. Moving trains use synthesized rail-joint knocks. Horns use the locally stored CC0 locomotive recording below, with a multi-chime Web Audio fallback if it cannot load. Facility effects are synthesized locally.

horn.title: Locomotive Train Horn
horn.author: thet00nedl00n
horn.changes: Public high-quality MP3 preview; excerpt starts at 0.19 seconds and lasts 2.72 seconds; mono 44100 Hz / 128 kbit MP3; high-pass 65 Hz, 25 ms fade-in, 200 ms fade-out, loudness normalization -16 LUFS / -3 dBTP. Short calls use a runtime envelope; not a recording of a specific KAI locomotive.
